about_the_game:
About

A coma is a condition in which a person is neither alive nor dead. Just like a comma, it is not a sign to end a story, but a sentence stops there. People don't know what really happens when someone is in a coma. Is it just dark, or is there something else? No one knows, neither did Emma, the little girl who is forced to stop.

You will play as Emma, a young child in a coma. Emma wakes up in a dream world with no clues at all. Along the way, Emma will encounter many puzzles that will provide clues as to what happened to her. Slowly, Emma will be shown her condition before she falls into a coma. Every environment that Emma encounters is a manifestation of Emma's condition.

Features

  • Explore a mysterious world with a different environment to find the truth behind the coma condition.
  • Encounter creatures to guide your journey.
  • A side-scrolling puzzle representing conditions in a coma.
  • Hidden memories in each environment.
